column2: Is he all right?

column2:

the finishing touches on the Shagohod.

column2: Good. That means they haven't killed him...

column2:

they'll have no more use for him.

killing him if he thinks the CIA is closing in.

column2:

sight.

column2:

Grad is?

column2:
Granin told me that I should be able to get
there from the mountains to the north
through an underground tunnel...
column3:

column2: Granin told you?
column3: Granin told you?

column2:
Yeah. He even gave me the key to
the warehouse.
column3:

the warehouse.

column2: Why?
column3: Why?

column2: Because he was drunk, I guess.
column3: Because he was drunk, I guess.

column2: You've got to be kidding me.
column3: You've got to be kidding me.

column2: Hell if I know.
column3: Hell if I know.

column2: Snake, there's one problem with that route.
column3: Snake, there's one problem with that route.

column2: What problem?
column3: What problem?

column2:
The mountain entrance to the underground
tunnel that leads to the fortress is sealed.
You need a key to get in.
column3:

column2:

me?

column2: That key won't work.
column3: That key won't work.

column2: But don't worry. I'll figure something out.
column3: But don't worry. I'll figure something out.

column2: Snake, tu es là?
column3: Snake, tu es là?

column2: EVA? Où es-tu?
column3: EVA? Où es-tu?

column2:
Dans la forteresse - à Groznyj Grad. Le Dr.
Sokolov est là aussi.
column3:

column2: Est-ce qu'il va bien?

column2:

les touches finales au Shagohod.
column3:

column2:
Tant mieux. Cela veut dire qu'ils ne l'ont pas
encore tué...

column2:
En tout cas, pas encore. Tu ferais bien de te

Phase 2.
column3:

column2:

tunnel souterrain...

column3: Ouais, c'est ça...

column3: Quel problème?
